end.summary:
Practised defining a community as people who live in one place and help or depend on each other.
Used examples of neighbours providing milk, running a shop, and delivering papers.
Dev said working together can make tasks easier and identified shared work for water.
Teach-back was not yet passed; the idea remained somewhat confusing at the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the community idea through familiar neighbourhood examples and by asking what happens when people work together. Dev connected teamwork with making tasks easier and gave a shared-water example. Dev mixed up the idea with a dinosaur living alone; this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, ask Dev to name three people in a community and explain how each person helps or depends on others.
